question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Adversity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Adversity"** means a difficult or unpleasant situation. (कठिनाई)

 
 
• **Example: **She showed great courage in the face of adversity.
 
 
 
• **"Misfortune"** refers to bad luck or an unlucky event. (दुर्भाग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **He had the misfortune of losing his wallet on the trip.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Adversity'** is **'Misfortune'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Success** (सफलता): The accomplishment of an aim or purpose.

 
 
• **Example:** His hard work led to great success in his career.
 
 
 
• **Pleasure** (सुख): A feeling of happy satisfaction and enjoyment.
 
 
• **Example:** She finds great pleasure in reading books.
 
 
 
• **Advantage** (लाभ): A condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable or superior position.
 
 
• **Example:** Having a car gives you an advantage when traveling long distances.
